Class ElmNode

java.lang.Object
network.ike.foundation.ike.elm.ElmNode
public final class ElmNode extends Object
One ELM node as it is being built: its kind, the plain values it holds by position, the nodes it holds by position, the roles first, second, and third, and the ordered lists it points at. Each verb refuses a position the kind does not have, or a position asked for in the wrong form, at once and in plain words; counts and value kinds are checked when the tree is built.
